title: Pointwise flatness criterion on a quasi-finite polynomial chart
statement: Let $T$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-affine-spectrum], $f:X\to T$ flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and $U\subseteq X$ an affine open. Let $n\ge0$ and let $e:U\to\mathbb A^n_T$ [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] be locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], with composition with the projection equal to $f|_U$. For each $x\in U$, the local-ring map induced by $e$ at $x$ is flat if and only if the depth of the fibre local ring of $f$ at $x$ equals its ring Krull dimension and the topological Krull dimension of that fibre at $x$ equals $n$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk; def-weil-pbc-depth; def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring; def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point].

source.place: Tags 00RE and 00R7, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00RE and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R7; pointwise argument in Tag 00RH, with Tag 00N8; read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Work in A = Gamma(T) and B = Gamma(U), with P = A[t_1,...,t_n]. The factorization is an A-algebra map P to B. The open immersion U into X induces open immersions of fibres and isomorphisms of their stalks; dimension at a point agrees with dimension at that point in an open subspace. Thus compute both invariants using B tensor_A kappa(p), where p is the contraction of the prime of x. Localization and tensor base change identify the fibre stalk and the source polynomial fibre local ring.

The polynomial fibre local ring is regular. The target fibre local ring is Noetherian, since B tensor_A kappa(p) is finite type over a field. Quasi-finiteness gives an isolated point of the closed fibre, hence an Artinian local closed fibre and a finite residue extension. The two residue-field transcendence degrees are equal. The dimension-at-point formula and the hypothesis that the target fibre dimension at x is n give equality of source and target local dimensions. Cohen-Macaulayness of the target is exactly its depth equality, so miracle flatness gives flatness of the fibre local map. The Artinian closed-fibre assertion can also be obtained directly from the Artinian fibre instance in Mathlib/RingTheory/QuasiFinite/Basic.lean:77, since the chart map is quasi-finite; localization preserves the Artinian property.

Localize the base at p. The two local algebras are essentially finitely presented over A_p, and B_x is nonzero and finitely presented over itself. It is A_p-flat by flatness of f, and its closed fibre is flat over the polynomial closed fibre by the preceding step. The fibrewise flatness criterion gives flatness of the polynomial stalk map.

Conversely a flat polynomial stalk map remains flat after base change to kappa(p). Its regular local source and Artinian closed fibre have depths equal to their respective dimensions, the latter zero. The flat local depth formula computes target depth as source dimension. The quasi-finite dimension inequality and faithful-flat local dimension inequality give equality of source and target dimensions (a nonzero flat local map is faithfully flat). Thus target depth equals dimension. The finite residue extension and the field dimension-at-point formula give fibre dimension n; affine n-space has dimension at each point n. For the regular local source, a regular system of parameters gives depth at least dimension, and depth-le-support-dimension gives the reverse inequality. For the nonzero Artinian local closed fibre the same inequality and dimension zero give depth zero.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_flat_stalk_iff_fibre_depth_and_dimension
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e] [LocallyQuasiFinite e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme) :
    (e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ↔
      (IsLocalRing.depth
          (R := (f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x)))
          ((f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x))) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
        ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x))) ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (U.ι x)) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
